description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurses (RNs) to join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT. This is an exceptional opportunity for RNs looking for flexibility, with both full-time and part-time positions available. You will play a vital role in providing high-quality, patient-centered care in the comfort of patients' homes, making a direct impact on their well-being and recovery.

As a Home Health RN, you will manage a diverse caseload, performing comprehensive assessments, developing individualized care plans, and administering skilled nursing care. This role offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to delivering excellent care. Join a supportive team dedicated to empowering patients to achieve their health goals.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or a related clinical setting
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and documentation skills
Ability to travel within the Billings area to patient homes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $125,000, based on experience and contract type (full-time or part-time).

description: Join a dedicated team as a Full-time Registered Nurse (RN) in Casper, WY, where you will provide essential, compassionate care to patients in the comfort of their own homes. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on individual lives, offering personalized attention and fostering strong patient relationships within a supportive environment. In this vital role, you will manage a diverse caseload, performing comprehensive assessments, developing individualized care plans, and administering treatments. We are seeking a proactive and empathetic professional eager to contribute to patient well-being and recovery. The position offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment to high-quality home health services.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Wyoming
Minimum of one year of clinical experience, preferably in home health, acute care, or a similar setting
Demonstrated strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
Ability to work autonomously and manage a patient caseload effectively
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
Join a premier healthcare provider in New York City, NY, seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine Physician (MD). This role offers a unique opportunity to focus on workers' compensation and no-fault/lien cases, operating outside of major medical insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid systems. We are looking for a physician who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to providing exceptional patient care.

This position is structured with a competitive compensation package, approximately $180,000 per year, heavily weighted towards performance-based bonuses. Candidates must be prepared to work weekends to meet patient needs. If you are a WCB-certified physician with experience in workers' compensation, this could be an excellent fit for your expertise.
requirements: Valid New York State medical license
Experience with workers' compensation or no-fault/lien cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is approximately $180,000 per year, with a significant portion derived from performance-based bonuses.
